text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Symboli Kris S opened up her heart to her 
Trainer. Devoid of "passion," she wondered 
if she was truly capable of sparking a 
"revolution."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her Trainer, however, claims that "heat" 
is unnecessary. For other Umamusume are 
already burning hot, purely to overcome 
Symboli Kris S's "cold calm."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Through the results she has built, Symboli 
Kris S is already transforming Japanese 
racing. There is no need for her to become 
the standard-bearer of "revolution."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Trainer tells Symboli Kris S that she 
should simply become an absolute 
powerhouse and serve as everyone's 
"ordeal." Hearing those words frees her 
from her doubts.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She aimed to make her mark in all three: 
the Tenno Sho (Autumn), the Japan Cup, and 
the Arima Kinen. Her first resolution was 
to defend her title at the Tenno Sho 
(Autumn).
